mapper.select: SELECT invalid.id FROM ( WITH , recipient_documents AS ( SELECT id, u_id AS document FROM assess_flows UNION ALL SELECT id, role_id AS document FROM assess_flows ), checked_documents AS ( SELECT id, COALESCE(JSON_VALID(document), 0) AS valid, CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(document) = 1 THEN document ELSE 'null' END AS document FROM recipient_documents ) SELECT d.id FROM checked_documents d WHERE d.valid = 0 OR JSON_TYPE(d.document) <> 'ARRAY' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE( CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(d.document) = 'ARRAY' THEN d.document ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS (position FOR ORDINALITY) ) elements WHERE CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.document, CONCAT('$[', elements.position - 1, ']'))) IN ('INTEGER', 'STRING') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.document, CONCAT('$[', elements.position - 1, ']'))) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]{1,10}$' THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.document, CONCAT('$[', elements.position - 1, ']'))) AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) NOT BETWEEN -2147483648 AND 2147483647 ELSE TRUE END ) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 1 ) invalid

SELECT paged.* FROM (
SELECT a.projectId, a.userId, a.score, a.status, p.title AS projectName, p.start_time AS startTime, p.end_time AS endTime, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.user_name AS userName, u.major FROM assess_filtered a JOIN assess_projects p ON p.id = a.projectId JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = a.userId ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.projectId ASC, a.userId ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit} ) paged ORDER BY paged.score DESC, paged.projectId ASC, paged.userId ASC

select ta.u_id as uId, ta.role_id as roleId, po.id as projectId from sys_project as po, sys_flow as fo, sys_flow_task as ta where po.status != 3 and po.id = #{pId} and fo.status = 1 and ta.status = 1 and po.id = fo.p_id and fo.id = ta.parent_id and ta.type = 'CC'

select distinct year(start_time) as years from sys_project where status = 1
and id in
#{pId}
order by years desc

select one.pname as 'category',one.project_id, one.id as 'parentId',two.id, two.pname, two.standard, two.score, two.is_file, two.is_extend, two.remark from sys_project_item one left join sys_project_item two on one.id = two.parent_id where one.project_id = #{projectId} and one.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY one.order_by, two.order_by
select A.id, A.title, A.describe, A.send_name sendName, A.start_time startTime, A.end_time endTime, A.create_time createTime, A.status, A.is_collect isCollect from sys_project A where id = #{id}
select year(start_time) as startTime from sys_project ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select po.id as projectId, fo.id as flowId, po.`title` as projectName, po.`create_time` as createTime, po.`end_time` as endTime from sys_project as po,sys_flow as fo where po.status != 3 and po.id = fo.p_id
select title from sys_project where status != 3 and id = #{pId}
